answer: A harbor only lets a ship dock when a known merchant vouches for it. Give each agent a short-lived work permit signed by a verified principal, like a wharf pass that expires in days. Renewal needs on-chain proof of delivered work, and if the agent is exposed as a fake, the principal's own stake is slashed. A garden of real employers will not risk their stake to sponsor a thousand clones, so farming identities costs the attacker a willing sponsor for every single one.
